verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs show native connectivity with Slack, both for tracking progress and through Jira automation, and point to a 3,000+ app Marketplace plus first-party Bitbucket, Confluence and Trello integrations. The pack never names GitHub or Google Drive, so only one of the three tools in the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of native GitHub integration, evidence of native Google Drive integration, depth of the Slack integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
